tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Linear filling bound on the torus] \group relative-invariant Source: thurston:page-0148

There is $K>0$ such that every homologically trivial $2$-cycle $z$ in $T^2$ bounds a chain $c$ with $\| c\| \leq K\| z\| $.
